Hi Camila,

Thank you for agreeing to register Redwood as a vendor for ArborLane. We're starting the AP onboarding so we can route POs and payables automatically. To avoid payment delays we need the items below completed within 7 business days: 

- Complete ArborLane Supplier Portal registration (we'll invite your account after we receive the portal form).
- Provide tax evidence: W-9 (US entity) or VAT registration for non-US entities.
- Add bank remit details and confirm ACH rails (bank name, IBAN/Account, SWIFT).
- Supply a sample invoice CSV that matches our PO mapping fields (see attached sample-invoice-arborlane.csv).
- Confirm PO matching keys: PO number (field: PO_NUM), line item code (ITEM_SKU), and supplier reference (SUPPLIER_ID).

I'm attaching our portal instructions and the sample CSV. Once you upload the documents, please reply with the portal confirmation link and estimated date for being able to accept POs.

Also a quick note on VAT: if Redwood will be invoicing ArborLane EU entities, we need your EU VAT number and a self-billing preference (if applicable). For US payments we'll issue ACH to the account you provide.

Best,
Marta Silva
Accounts Payable Lead

Hi Camila / Marissa / Logan — appreciate the quick turnaround and the sample CSV. A few clarifications from our AP and procurement teams: 

- Vendor invite has been sent to vendor@redwood.ai; please complete the registration link today so activation can begin.
- PO matching: ArborLane supports consolidated invoicing. PO_NUM at the invoice header is acceptable, but we recommend including PO_LINE_REF when multiple POs are combined to ensure automated matching. We'll accept either approach but PO_LINE_REF reduces manual reconciliation.
- VAT: For EU billing we can accept a supplier self-billing arrangement; send the self-billing consent form and we will sign. If Redwood registers an EU VAT number later, please update the portal record.
- Payment terms: Standard Net30 for new suppliers. Early Pay (2%/10) is available via our finance partner — let us know interest.
- Required international tax evidence: W-9 is fine for US; if payments route to a non-US entity later we'll request W-8BEN-E.

I confirmed vendor activation will be completed after the portal upload and bank verification (expected within 2 business days of upload). Please reply when the portal form is complete and attach the bank verification PDF.
